svg.title: SIE, noff and intena through kwait
svg.desc: A timeline of nineteen steps on one hart. Rows show which thread runs, the SIE bit, noff as filled squares, and intena. The parent acquires wait_lock, registers with sleep_prepare, releases wait_lock (interrupts on), takes its p->lock and switches to the scheduler, which sets intena to 0 and releases the lock. Later the scheduler switches back, sched restores intena 1, and kwait nests wait_lock, the child's p->lock and kmem.lock to noff 3 before releasing all three and turning interrupts back on.
svg.text: 7: sched keeps the parent's intena (1) in register s3 across swtch.
8: the scheduler forces intena to 0, so its release leaves interrupts off.
12: back in sched, the parent's 1 is put back; 13 turns interrupts on.
14 to 19: the deepest nesting measured, noff 3, with interrupts off throughout.
